messages:
alex: Quick heads up — PR #1459 running into a couple of small style/lint things. CI shows ruff errors and import ordering. Also one rename suggestion on telemetry/metrics.go (exported function should be PascalCase). Can someone pick this up? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1459

maya: I can take a pass in ~30m. if it's just ruff/isort + a rename should be quick. do you want the rename as a separate commit or squash?

alex: separate commit is fine, simpler to revert if needed. thanks!

jin: fyi the ruff failures are mainly E402 and F401 (top-level imports and unused). run `ruff check --fix` locally then `isort .` — that fixes 90% of it. for go file: `TelemetryClient` -> `TelemetryReporter` was suggested in review, but either is okay as long as consistent.

ci-bot: [ci/checks] ruff: failed — 7 errors, 2 warnings. isort: failed — import order violations. gofmt: OK.

maya: grabbed it. pushed two commits: `fix: ruff autofixes` and `refactor: TelemetryReporter rename` — PTAL. I left a note on the rename commit about backwards compatibility in case anyone's importing directly.

tess: quick review — ruff fixes look good. small nit: keep the import groups (std, external, internal) separated by a blank line in metrics_test.go. also can you run `gofmt -w` on the repo? spotted one trailing space.

jin: approving after the import blankline change. also can we update the changelog line for telemetry rename? just a single note under internal changelog.

maya: added the blank line and changelog note. pushed a tiny followup commit. ran `ruff check` and `isort` locally — green.

ci-bot: [ci/checks] ruff: passed. isort: passed. unit tests: passed.

alex: thanks all — lgtm. merging in the next 10m during merge window. :shipit:

tess: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:

jin: nice! will watch for downstream test flakiness but should be safe.

maya: merged and deployed the small service change. monitoring looks clean. closing the PR.

alex: perfect, appreciate the quick async coordination.
